column1: # slug|impact,uniqueness,significance,experience,depth|category overrides or -|individual rationale

semmering-railway|8.2,9.2,9.4,8.2,8.1|-|Pioneering mountain railway deserves high engineering significance, not palace-level immersion or discovery on an ordinary train journey; contrast Alishan Forest Railway and Hohensalzburg Fortress.

admont-abbey-library|8.6,9.0,8.8,8.6,7.4|-|Exceptional Baroque interior and monastic collection, but one library hall has much less visitor depth than a major art museum; compare National Palace Museum.
austrian-national-library-state-hall|8.7,9.0,8.9,8.6,7.6|-|Remarkable monumental library room; contained one-room visitor experience does not equal Forbidden City or Hofburg museum depth.
spanish-riding-school|8.5,9.1,9.0,8.5,8.2|-|Distinctive living equestrian tradition, but performance and training visit has less breadth than a large cultural museum or palace.
hallstatt-salt-mine|8.7,8.9,8.9,8.9,8.1|-|Historically meaningful mine-tour experience; avoid transferring the full Hallstatt landscape or town significance to the underground tour.
melk-abbey|9.0,9.2,9.3,9.2,8.7|-|Outstanding abbey architecture and tour, but the site lacks the globally singular breadth of the largest imperial ensembles.

hochosterwitz-castle|8.7,8.9,8.8,8.8,8.1|-|Memorable hilltop castle and multiple gates, yet regional fortification significance and visit depth are below internationally exceptional fortress complexes.
mozarts-birthplace|8.1,8.7,9.3,8.2,7.6|-|Mozart's international importance is not equivalent to the scale or interpretive depth of the small birthplace museum.
schloss-eggenberg|8.6,8.9,9.0,8.8,8.7|-|Important Graz palace with rooms and gardens, but not interchangeable with globally defining royal palace ensembles.
carnuntum-archaeological-park|8.7,8.9,9.0,8.8,8.4|-|Substantial Roman heritage interpretation, but archaeological scope does not rival Angkor or Ayutthaya city-scale ensembles.
eisriesenwelt-werfen|9.0,9.4,8.8,9.0,8.4|-|Superb ice-cave formation and guided visit, while significance and practical exploration are more limited than massive cave systems.
krimml-waterfalls|9.0,9.0,8.5,9.1,8.3|-|Powerful three-stage waterfall walk; the worldwide natural-science importance is below singular karst or waterfall systems.
grossglockner-summit|9.0,8.8,8.6,8.9,8.4|-|Major alpine summit with demanding outdoor experience; distinguish one peak from the entire Hohe Tauern National Park.
vienna-state-opera|9.0,9.2,9.3,9.1,8.7|-|Exceptional performance venue and architectural heritage; distinguish interior tour from full global significance of opera as a performing art.
st-stephens-cathedral|9.1,9.2,9.3,9.1,8.8|-|Vienna's landmark Gothic cathedral, but visitor breadth does not match top multi-building heritage ensembles.
belvedere-palace|9.0,9.1,9.2,9.2,9.0|-|Palace and Klimt collection justify very high culture; avoid valuing it like the entire wider imperial palace network.
mauthausen-memorial|9.1,9.4,9.8,9.0,8.8|-|Profound Holocaust and forced-labor history warrants exceptional significance; separate emotional impact and scope from an entire multi-site museum network.
natural-history-museum-vienna|8.7,8.8,8.8,9.1,9.1|-|Excellent natural-history collection and architecture, but globally outstanding category does not require nearly perfect core significance.

grossglockner-high-alpine-road|9.2,9.1,8.9,9.5,8.9|-|48-km alpine panorama road offers several exhibitions and many stops; distinctive road but less ecological and exploratory scope than the entire Hohe Tauern protected area. Retain outstanding experience, slightly constrain global historical significance. Source: https://www.grossglockner.at/en/article/zeitplanung-ausflug_a829

hofburg-palace|9.3,9.3,9.6,9.3,9.6|-|Retain top-tier integrated imperial palace and museums: Imperial Apartments and Sisi Museum offer meaningful site-specific depth beyond a ceremonial building. Source: https://www.sisimuseum-hofburg.at/en/about-the-location/imperial-apartments

hohe-tauern-national-park|9.4,9.1,9.0,9.5,9.4|-|Retain exceptional alpine landscape depth: 1856 square kilometres of glaciated peaks and diverse natural habitats, not merely one panoramic road or summit. Source: https://www.nationalpark.at/en/nationalpark

hohensalzburg-fortress|9.1,9.1,9.3,9.4,8.9|-|Retain rare intact medieval hill fortress, architectural/urban panorama and substantive museums, as a complete structure rather than borrowing Salzburg citywide fame. UNESCO setting and historical value compared with other castles. Source: https://whc.unesco.org/en/statesparties/at

kunsthistorisches-museum|9.2,9.4,9.6,9.4,9.5|-|Retain high-ranked encyclopedic imperial museum and strong permanent Old Master holdings; globally competitive museum collection with meaningful sustained visitor depth. Compared against National Palace Museum and National Museum of Korea. Source: https://www.khm.at/en/

schoenbrunn-palace|9.4,9.3,9.6,9.5,9.3|-|Retain verified world-renowned Habsburg palace and garden ensemble: heritage, architecture and large grounds genuinely support global palace-scale visitor depth. Source: https://whc.unesco.org/en/statesparties/at

wachau-valley|8.9,8.8,9.2,9.4,9.6|-|Retain broad valley-scale exploration; Danube riverscape, vineyard terraces, monasteries and settlements form a coherent UNESCO cultural landscape rather than one point or viewpoint. Source: https://whc.unesco.org/en/list/970

gesaeuse-national-park|8.9,8.8,8.7,9.1,9.2|nature=9.4|Gesäuse National Park contains dramatic Enns river gorges, limestone walls, endemic species and extensive mountain hiking; global significance is meaningful but does not equal the planet's most vast national parks. Source: https://www.nationalparksaustria.at/en/national-park-gesaeuse.html

wildspitze|8.7,8.4,7.7,8.5,7.8|-|Wildspitze is Austria's second-highest peak and demands a serious mountaineering glacier ascent; its individual summit visit has comparatively limited global historic singularity versus entire alpine ranges. Source: https://www.pitztaler-gletscher.at/en/pitztal-glacier-and-rifflsee/summer/mountaineering-and-hiking/die-wildspitze.html

bregenz-floating-stage|8.7,9.1,8.8,8.7,7.5|culture=9.3|Bregenz Seebühne is documented as the world's largest lake stage and an internationally prominent summer opera production venue, yet its memorable full experience is performance-dependent rather than a standalone day-long museum. Source: https://www.festspielhausbregenz.com/en/event-planning/venue-rental/seebuehne/

nordkette-hafelekar|8.6,8.3,7.2,8.8,8.2|-|Hafelekar provides striking Karwendel panoramas directly above Innsbruck via connected cableways and hiking trails; impressive access and city view do not create world-defining scientific or historical uniqueness. Source: https://nordkette.com/en/top-of-innsbruck/

hohenwerfen-castle|8.7,8.6,8.7,9.0,8.5|architecture=9.0,history=8.8|Hohenwerfen is a richly visitable medieval cliff-top fortress with interior tours, falconry shows and several exhibitions; its tourist experience is stronger than a mere external photo stop, though less globally singular than great imperial fortresses. Source: https://www.burg-hohenwerfen.at/en/your-visit

kalkalpen-national-park|8.7,9.0,9.1,8.6,9.0|nature=9.4,wildlife=9.2|Kalkalpen National Park contains internationally important old-growth beech forests within a UNESCO serial natural property; strong ecological and forest depth merit better scores, but typical visitor experience is narrower than alpine panorama parks. Source: https://www.nationalparksaustria.at/en/national-park-kalkalpen.html

neusiedler-see-seewinkel-national-park|8.5,8.8,9.2,8.7,8.8|nature=9.1,wildlife=9.4|Neusiedler See–Seewinkel protects internationally significant Central European steppe wetlands and migratory bird habitat within Ramsar and a wider UNESCO cultural landscape; scientific merit is high without assuming universally spectacular scenery. Source: https://www.bmluk.gv.at/themen/wasser/wasser-eu-international/europaeische-und-internationale-wasserwirtschaft/feuchtgebiete/ramsar/neusiedlersee.html

gosausee|8.4,8.0,6.8,8.8,7.1|nature=9.0,photography=9.2|Vorderer Gosausee has exceptional reflected Dachstein mountain scenery and a comfortable lake circuit, but as a single small alpine lake its global geomorphological significance and independent exploration depth are modest. Source: https://dachstein.salzkammergut.at/en/visitor-information/our-lakes/lake-gosau.html

achensee|8.4,8.0,7.1,8.8,8.4|-|Achensee is Tirol's largest lake with boat routes, lakeside towns and accessible mountain sports, providing meaningful recreation but not globally unrepeatable geological or historical heritage. Source: https://www.achensee.com/en/travel-information/facts-figures/

dachstein-skywalk|8.4,8.1,6.5,8.6,6.5|photography=9.1|The Dachstein Sky Walk is a dramatic glass viewing platform above a cliff, but the attraction itself is a short photo stop and must not inherit the entire glacier area's geological and trekking depth. Source: https://www.derdachstein.at/en/dachstein-glacier-world/attractions/sky-walk?vicarage=0

zillertal-alps|8.9,8.9,8.1,9.1,9.6|nature=9.2,adventure=9.3|Zillertal Alps nature park spans extensive high mountain wilderness and trails, justifying major hiking depth and memorable alpine scenery, without treating all individual summits as equally irreplaceable worldwide. Source: https://www.naturpark-zillertal.at/der-naturpark.html

schafberg|8.5,8.1,7.1,8.8,7.5|photography=9.2|Schafberg offers spectacular Salzkammergut lake panoramas reached by historic cog railway or mountain hike, but the mountain viewpoint should not inherit the railway's separate historic engineering significance or the whole lake region's depth. Source: https://www.5schaetze.at/en/schafbergbahn.html

hallstaetter-see|8.4,8.2,7.2,8.6,8.1|nature=9.0|Lake Hallstatt is a scenic boating and walking destination framing the UNESCO Hallstatt cultural landscape, but its standalone lake significance must remain separate from the famous salt-mining town's full history. Source: https://dachstein.salzkammergut.at/en/visitor-information/our-lakes/lake-hallstatt.html

dachstein-krippenstein-five-fingers|8.4,8.2,6.4,8.6,6.3|photography=9.2|Five Fingers provides a dramatic elevated Hallstatt panorama from one viewing platform, but a short lookout should not inherit either the Dachstein massif or the surrounding UNESCO Salzkammergut region's independent visitor depth. Source: https://www.dachstein-salzkammergut.com/en/sommer/oberirdisch/5fingers

swarovski-crystal-worlds|8.1,8.4,7.3,8.6,8.5|-|Swarovski Crystal Worlds has international art installations, contemporary galleries and family garden attractions since 1995, meriting a rewarding modern-art visit without borrowing the broader history of Tyrolean towns. Source: https://www.kristallwelten.swarovski.com/en

luenersee|8.6,8.3,6.8,8.7,7.8|-|Lünersee offers an exceptionally scenic mountain lake circuit and nearby alpine hikes, but one cable-car-accessible lake has lower scientific singularity and site depth than an entire national park. Source: https://www.luenersee.at/en/service-prices/opening-times

silvretta-high-alpine-road|8.4,8.1,7.0,8.4,8.2|-|Silvretta High Alpine Road combines engineering and spectacular alpine bends, but is one road rather than an entire mountain reserve; official Austrian tourism says the full road remains closed through 2029, so visitor access must be noted separately. Source: https://www.austria.info/en-us/locations/silvretta-high-alpine-road/

kaprun-high-mountain-reservoirs|8.5,8.6,7.8,8.8,8.3|-|Kaprun mountain reservoirs provide dramatic dam engineering, scenic transfers, guided hydropower interpretation and trails, making a more substantive engineering visit than a roadside stop but below world-defining ancient water systems. Source: https://visit.verbund.com/en/kaprun

neusiedler-see|8.1,8.3,8.2,8.4,8.6|-|Neusiedler See is a broad steppe lake with cycling, sailing and cultural landscape around its shores, but the lake itself should not inherit all the ecology of its Seewinkel national park or full UNESCO cross-border landscape. Source: https://whc.unesco.org/en/list/772

nockberge-biosphere-reserve|8.5,8.4,8.8,8.6,9.0|-|Nockberge Biosphere Park protects distinctive round-topped alpine ecosystems, traditional land-use and multi-day hiking trails, with strong landscape depth but less global uniqueness than major high glaciated ranges. Source: https://www.unesco.org/en/mab/salzburger-lungau-karntner-nockberge

erzberg-mine|8.3,8.9,8.7,8.9,8.1|-|The active Erzberg iron-ore open pit combines striking mining terraces, giant-truck excursions and underground guided mining history, offering high experiential and industrial-heritage distinctiveness without UNESCO-scale antiquity. Source: https://www.abenteuer-erzberg.at/en/preise-und-besucherinformation

kitzsteinhorn|8.5,8.4,7.3,8.8,8.4|-|Kitzsteinhorn offers 3000-metre glacier overlooks, lifts, walking and educational exhibits, a high-quality mountain visit but not an ecologically or historically singular world-standard alpine summit. Source: https://www.kitzsteinhorn.at/en/explore/summer/sightseeing

altausseer-see|8.1,7.8,6.7,8.5,7.6|-|Lake Altaussee presents a clean alpine basin under Loser with boating and easy shoreline walks; outstanding regional serenity but many globally comparable mountain lakes exist. Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lake_Altaussee

ambras-castle|8.2,8.6,8.8,8.5,8.5|-|Ambras Castle houses Ferdinand II's exceptionally early museum collections and historical portrait gallery, a more substantial cultural visit than an ordinary hilltop castle. Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ambras_Castle

aqua-dome-laengenfeld|7.4,7.5,6.2,8.6,7.2|-|Aqua Dome is a contemporary thermal spa resort valued for pools and striking outdoor bowl architecture; comfort is high but global heritage and irreplaceability are modest.

ars-electronica-center|8.2,8.6,8.5,8.9,8.8|-|Linz's Ars Electronica Center presents interactive digital-art and emerging-technology exhibitions, with strong hands-on depth that should exceed a standard static local museum.

attersee|8.1,7.7,6.7,8.2,8.0|-|Attersee is a large clear Salzkammergut lake associated with swimming and watersports and with Gustav Klimt's landscapes; a standalone lake still has lower global scientific rarity. Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Attersee_(lake)

bergisel-ski-jump|7.9,8.5,8.3,8.2,6.8|-|Bergisel combines Zaha Hadid's dramatic modern ski-jump tower and Olympic winter-sport tradition, but a short tower outlook cannot match a full alpine museum district. Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bergisel_Ski_Jump

brandnertal|7.7,7.1,6.2,8.4,8.5|-|Brandnertal is a broad Vorarlberg alpine valley with multiple hiking and recreation areas, giving regional depth without rare world-scale geology or history. Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Brandnertal

bregenzerwald|8.3,8.2,7.8,8.7,8.7|-|Bregenzerwald offers dispersed wooden architecture, alpine agriculture and multiple villages and mountains; regional cultural landscape is richer than a single lookout, though globally replaceable.

central-cemetery-vienna|7.6,8.0,8.8,8.1,8.8|-|Vienna Central Cemetery contains major historical musicians' and statesmen's graves, architecture, and expansive grounds; its cultural significance and walkable depth are stronger than a small memorial. Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vienna_Central_Cemetery

dachstein-ice-caves|8.3,8.8,7.0,8.5,7.4|-|Dachstein Ice Caves contain striking seasonal ice formations on a guided cave circuit, but the discrete cave should not inherit the whole Dachstein massif's UNESCO landscape score.

duernstein-castle-ruins|7.8,7.6,7.8,8.1,6.4|-|Dürnstein Castle ruins are associated with the captivity of Richard I and offer Wachau views; relatively sparse surviving masonry limits exploration despite famous history. Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/D%C3%BCrnstein_Castle

ehrenberg-castle-ruins|7.9,7.7,8.0,8.1,7.6|-|Ehrenberg has atmospheric Tyrolean fortification ruins above Reutte with connected defensive sites, but the surviving visitor experience does not match a fully preserved imperial fortress. Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ehrenberg_Castle

esterhazy-palace-eisenstadt|8.3,8.5,8.7,8.5,8.0|-|Esterházy Palace has a major aristocratic interior and Haydn performance history in Eisenstadt; strong Baroque heritage but smaller scale than Schönbrunn and Hofburg.

forchtenstein-castle|8.0,8.2,8.7,8.2,8.0|-|Forchtenstein is a well-preserved Esterházy fortress with arms and treasury collections, meriting historic depth while lacking Hohensalzburg's landmark setting and wider influence. Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Forchtenstein_Castle
gastein-waterfall|7.9,7.8,6.8,8.1,6.7|-|Gastein Waterfall cascades spectacularly through a built-up spa town, providing a distinctive streetscape view but a short standalone nature visit.

goettweig-abbey|8.3,8.7,8.7,8.5,8.4|-|Göttweig Abbey is a monumental Benedictine complex above the Wachau with ornate imperial staircase and museum rooms; significant Baroque heritage but below Melk Abbey's visitor scope. Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/G%C3%B6ttweig_Abbey

golden-roof-innsbruck|7.4,7.8,8.2,7.8,5.7|-|The Golden Roof is a small ornate late-Gothic viewing loggia reflecting Maximilian I's court in Innsbruck, important as a photo stop rather than a deep independent visit.
grafenegg-castle|7.7,7.8,7.5,8.3,8.0|-|Grafenegg Castle combines historicist architecture and landscaped concert grounds; the event programme offers more value than the architectural visit alone.
graz-clock-tower|7.6,7.8,7.5,8.2,6.4|-|The Uhrturm is Graz's recognizable Schlossberg landmark and city panorama, but a single tower viewpoint cannot inherit the wider UNESCO old-town architecture.

gruener-see|8.6,9.1,6.6,8.6,6.6|-|Grüner See is an unusually vivid, seasonally fluctuating clear mountain lake that floods surrounding paths, giving rare photographic character but only a compact shoreline visit. Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gr%C3%BCner_See_(Styria)

grundlsee|7.9,7.5,6.1,8.3,8.0|-|Grundlsee is a spacious Salzkammergut boating and recreation lake with mountain scenery, but its worldwide geological singularity remains limited. Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Grundlsee

hallstatt-skywalk|7.9,8.0,6.4,8.5,6.3|-|Hallstatt Skywalk overlooks the UNESCO village and lake from an engineered platform; panoramic appeal is high but it is a short stop, not the entire salt-mine heritage experience.

hardegg-castle|7.7,8.0,7.7,7.6,6.7|-|Hardegg's medieval castle dominates the small Thaya river settlement and is visually distinctive, while limited independent interpretation keeps visitor depth modest.

heiligenkreuz-abbey|8.2,8.8,9.0,8.4,8.2|-|Heiligenkreuz is an exceptionally enduring active Cistercian monastery with historic cloister, Romanesque architecture and religious community; meaningful culture without expansive museum collections. Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Heiligenkreuz_Abbey

hellbrunn-palace|8.8,9.3,8.5,9.4,8.7|-|Hellbrunn's Renaissance Mannerist trick fountains are exceptionally engaging historic water-theatre engineering within palace gardens, a distinctive extended tour unlike an ordinary ornamental garden.

highline179-suspension-bridge|8.0,8.3,6.5,8.4,5.8|-|Highline179 provides a dramatic pedestrian suspension crossing above the Reutte valley, but it is a modern short thrill stop and not a historic heritage experience.

hintertux-glacier|8.2,8.0,6.8,8.7,8.4|-|Hintertux is a large lift-served glacier with year-round winter sports and alpine viewpoints, strong recreation but less globally singular than protected glacier landscapes. Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hintertux_Glacier

hohe-wand-nature-park|7.6,7.2,6.3,8.2,8.0|-|Hohe Wand offers accessible limestone cliffs, nature trails and family recreation near Vienna, but not the global biodiversity or scenic grandeur of Austria's major national parks. Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hohe_Wand_Nature_Park

hundertwasserhaus|8.1,9.0,8.4,7.6,5.8|-|Hundertwasserhaus is an internationally recognizable experimental Vienna apartment building, but the residential interiors are not generally visitable and a façade-viewing stop is short. Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hundertwasserhaus

kahlenberg|7.2,6.9,6.6,7.9,6.9|-|Kahlenberg is a pleasant Vienna Woods hilltop overlook with a historic association to the 1683 siege, but the present viewpoint is globally replaceable. Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kahlenberg

kaiservilla-bad-ischl|8.0,8.2,8.8,8.3,7.6|-|Bad Ischl's Imperial Villa was the summer residence of Franz Joseph and Elisabeth, retaining Habsburg interiors and gardens; meaningful court history but smaller than Vienna's major palaces.

karlskirche|8.5,8.7,8.9,8.4,7.6|-|Karlskirche is an exceptional high-Baroque Vienna church with a monumental dome, frescoes and varied architectural references; meaningful interior visit but not a whole cathedral precinct. Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Karlskirche

kaunertal-glacier-road|8.5,8.2,7.0,8.7,8.5|-|Kaunertal Glacier Road is a long panoramic alpine route rising through varied high-mountain environments to glacier viewpoints, with scenic depth but limited global historic uniqueness.

kitzbueheler-horn|8.1,7.8,6.5,8.5,7.9|-|Kitzbüheler Horn offers lifts, panoramic hiking and alpine gardens; a fine regional summit but not a globally exceptional mountain ecosystem. Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kitzb%C3%BCheler_Horn

klosterneuburg-abbey|8.3,8.6,8.9,8.4,8.7|-|Klosterneuburg Abbey has deep medieval Babenberg and Augustinian history, the Verdun Altar, Baroque rooms and cultural collections; strong depth relative to ordinary parish churches. Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Klosterneuburg_Abbey

kunsthaus-graz|8.3,9.1,8.1,8.4,8.0|-|Kunsthaus Graz is a highly distinctive contemporary biomorphic museum building whose exterior and temporary modern-art exhibitions justify unusual architecture, but not national museum heritage scope. Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kunsthaus_Graz
lammerklamm|7.5,7.4,6.2,8.0,7.1|-|Lammerklamm is a steep Salzburg river gorge with walkways and dramatic narrow walls, a rewarding short outdoor stop with many comparable alpine gorges worldwide.

landskron-monkey-mountain|6.7,7.0,5.8,7.8,6.7|-|Landskron monkey mountain offers guided observations of free-ranging Japanese macaques and family learning, but zoological appeal is not globally irreplaceable wildlife or historic significance.

laxenburg-castle-park|8.1,8.3,8.3,8.5,8.4|-|Laxenburg Castle Park is a large former Habsburg landscape garden featuring Franzensburg, lakes and paths, giving more exploration than an individual palace façade without global imperial uniqueness. Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Laxenburg_castles

liechtensteinklamm|8.8,8.8,7.2,9.0,8.1|-|Liechtensteinklamm has spectacular very narrow limestone walls and a notable engineered spiral staircase, supporting an immersive gorge walk but less world-unique science than a giant cave system. Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Liechtensteinklamm

loser-mountain|8.2,8.0,6.7,8.4,7.9|-|Loser above Altaussee has a scenic road and broad Salzkammergut lake views with mountain walks; its setting is memorable but a single accessible peak has limited historic singularity. Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Loser_(mountain)

malta-high-alpine-road|8.6,8.4,8.0,8.8,8.4|-|Malta High Alpine Road leads through a dramatic alpine valley to Kölnbrein Dam with guided engineering interpretation, offering more depth than a roadside overlook but less cultural significance than major historic railways.

millstaetter-see|8.1,7.7,6.3,8.5,8.4|-|Lake Millstatt is a sizable Carinthian recreation lake with boating, shore trails and nearby towns, high relaxation value but globally common alpine-lake qualities. Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Millst%C3%A4tter_See

minimundus|7.0,7.5,6.5,8.0,7.7|-|Minimundus displays miniature models of global monuments in Klagenfurt as a family learning park; the recreations are entertaining without inheriting the historic significance of the actual monuments. Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Minimundus

mirabell-palace-gardens|8.3,8.4,8.6,8.6,7.5|-|Mirabell combines a formal Baroque Salzburg garden and palace backdrop with famous city views, beautiful in its own right but a smaller visit than the wider UNESCO Salzburg historic core.

moenchsberg-viewpoints|8.0,7.2,6.4,8.5,7.5|-|Mönchsberg paths connect multiple attractive elevated Salzburg panoramas and museum approaches, but their principal merit is urban scenery rather than world-scale natural or historical rarity.

mondsee|7.6,7.2,6.1,8.2,7.8|-|Mondsee Lake offers accessible bathing, boating and attractive alpine shores with village excursions, broadly enjoyable while more replaceable worldwide than the region's unique heritage buildings. Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mondsee_(lake)

murinsel-graz|7.4,8.4,7.2,7.4,5.6|-|Murinsel is an unusual modern artificial island/footbridge installation in Graz's Mur River, architecturally memorable as a short visit rather than a major historic monument.

museumsquartier|8.5,8.7,8.3,9.0,9.0|-|Vienna's MuseumsQuartier is a broad cultural complex with major art museums, exhibitions and public plazas, offering extensive independent exploration beyond one art-gallery room. Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/MuseumsQuartier

myra-waterfalls|7.4,7.0,5.8,7.8,7.0|-|Myra Falls near Muggendorf has a family-friendly cascade trail with wooden bridges and several pools, attractive as a short regional nature visit but not rare on a worldwide scale. Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Myra_Falls_(Lower_Austria)

oetschergraben|8.2,8.3,6.8,8.6,8.4|-|Ötschergräben is a network of striking Lower Austrian ravines and walking paths near the Mariazell railway, giving substantial hiking scenery without globally singular geology.
ossiacher-see|7.9,7.5,6.3,8.3,8.1|-|Ossiacher See offers lakeside Carinthian villages, swimming and surrounding mountains, a rewarding holiday basin but not a globally unique natural landmark.

pfaender|7.8,7.6,6.7,8.3,7.5|-|Pfänder gives expansive views over Lake Constance and the Alps reached by cable car, with a manageable trail network and regional family attractions but modest global significance. Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pf%C3%A4nder

plansee|8.4,8.2,6.7,8.7,7.8|-|Plansee's steep mountain-sided clear water offers unusually scenic boating and hiking in Tyrol, though the standalone lake remains replaceable among global alpine water landscapes. Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Plansee

poestlingberg|7.6,7.7,7.0,8.2,7.3|-|Pöstlingberg above Linz combines a distinctive hilltop basilica, old tram route, family attraction and city views, but retains modest independent worldwide importance. Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/P%C3%B6stlingberg

prater-giant-ferris-wheel|8.0,8.6,8.6,8.3,6.4|-|Vienna's 1897 Giant Ferris Wheel is an internationally recognizable surviving historic amusement landmark, with notable engineering heritage but a brief single-ride experience.

pyramidenkogel-observation-tower|8.2,8.7,7.0,8.6,6.4|-|Pyramidenkogel's tall timber observation structure offers outstanding Wörthersee and Karawanks views; modern architectural uniqueness exceeds its historic significance and standalone depth.

rappenlochschlucht|7.5,7.3,6.4,8.0,7.0|-|Rappenloch Gorge is a short accessible Vorarlberg ravine with river engineering features and steep rock walls, a good regional trail rather than an internationally rare canyon.

rax-mountain|8.2,7.7,6.8,8.6,8.7|-|Rax provides broad limestone plateau hiking and one of Vienna's classic mountain excursion landscapes, with more day-hike breadth than a lookout but limited global uniqueness. Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rax_(mountain_range)

riegersburg-castle|8.4,8.7,8.6,8.6,8.4|-|Riegersburg's hilltop fortress has multiple preserved defensive gates, historical exhibitions and strong volcanic rock setting, a rich castle visit that is still below global imperial fortress landmarks.
